Excel formula errors (#NAME?) in the statistics block caused the weighted throughput calculation to fail validation.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError due to #NAME? errors in cells H46:L47. This indicates the workbook contains invalid function names or undefined named ranges in the statistics section. While the 'net metric' assertions passed, the final statistics block failed to match expected floating-point values, specifically in the range H46 through L47.
